body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to two creatures within 2 units. Compare this Action against each. On a success, deal 1 Piercing damage and pull that creature 1 unit toward you.

surges.html: Choose one creature damaged by this Action; apply Punctured.
If you are Unstable, ignore Unstable's restriction until this Action finishes resolving.

rider.title: CHIMERA ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Hooked Form. While maintained: You gain a secondary natural appendage with 2-unit reach that can manipulate unattended objects.
